# FieldShore v4 — Pre-Phase-J Deep Review — 2026-07-03

**Target:** `v4-redesign` @ `b8b43e1` (468 commits since the v3.19.1 fork; 46 commits since the 2026-07-01 audit).
**Question answered:** is the v4 code sound enough to enter Phase J (cutover, #138)?
**Method:** 14 shard×lens finder agents over `src/` (443 files / ~57k lines) + shipping config, each
scoped so no reviewer holds the whole branch; plain-code dedup; a referee pass against the
known-findings baseline (June-14 build audit, #408, #410, #399/#400 sim findings, open issues);
then adversarial verification — Critical/High findings judged by 3 independent lenses
(correctness / reproduce-from-code / severity-honesty, majority kill), Medium/Low by a skeptic
prompted to refute. Nothing reaches the findings list unverified. **No fixes applied.**

Known gap: the 2026-07-01 autonomous audit's REPORT.md exists only on Alex's machine (untracked),
so dedup ran against its GitHub-issue record (#408/#410) and the June-14 report instead.
